transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because for the past six months, I've been dealing with this overwhelming surge of energy and intense mood swings. One minute I feel incredibly euphoric and on top of the world, and the next I'm extremely irritable, while my thoughts just constantly race out of control. It's gotten to the point where I just can't seem to calm down.

During those periods of feeling euphoric or on top of the world, have you ever experienced a break from reality, such as seeing or hearing things others couldn't, or did you require hospitalization because your behavior became dangerous or uncontrollable?

Yes, I've definitely seen and heard things that others couldn't, and I've had some really strange beliefs during those times. These unusual experiences only ever happen when I am in the middle of one of my high, euphoric phases. I haven't been hospitalized, but it gets incredibly overwhelming.
Do you experience these hallucinations or strange beliefs only during your high, euphoric moods, or do they also occur at times when your mood is stable or you are feeling depressed?
They definitely only happen when I'm in those high, energetic states. When my mood is stable or if I'm feeling down, I don't experience those hallucinations or strange beliefs at all.
